people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

people.name: Salu
people.line: Father of Zimri, a Simeonite prince

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

people.name: Zimri
people.line: Simeonite prince, killed in the Baal-Peor incident

translations.web: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.
translations.bsb: The name of the Israelite who was slain with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.
translations.kjv: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
translations.asv: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers' house among the Simeonites.
